note: Valley County, NE publishes its official zoning map and regulations only as PDF documents on valleycountyne.gov (the county page was blocked with a 503 on retry, but third-party directories cite it as PDF). The county's ArcGIS Hub (gis-portal-valleycounty.hub.arcgis.com) holds parcels, municipal boundaries, flood and address layers but no zoning district layer; its Planning and Zoning map app has no zoning districts. The gWorks viewer (valley.gworks.com) exposes no zoning service. The Ord city site links only its comprehensive plan and municipal code PDFs. ArcGIS searches for Valley County and Ord zoning returned no queryable zoning district layer.
